nodes.label: AB-1001 Design
nodes.rationale: Pre-implementation design. The stack is fixed by SDS section 1 and AGENTS.md section 3. The draft API has no health route. Dependencies, Prisma migrations, and database work need approval. Gates run lint, then test, then build.

nodes.label: pnpm Workspace Layout
nodes.rationale: frontend, backend, and packages/shared sit under a root pnpm workspace and a strict tsconfig.base.json with noUncheckedIndexedAccess. Turborepo and Nx were rejected as extra dependencies the spec does not call for.

nodes.label: Built Shared Package
nodes.rationale: packages/shared is compiled to dist with tsc and consumed as workspace:*. Project references and path aliases were rejected because Vite and Node resolve them differently. Dev runs tsc --watch so dist does not go stale.

nodes.label: Exact Version Pinning
nodes.rationale: Node is pinned with .nvmrc and engines, pnpm with packageManager via Corepack, and dependencies are exact because .npmrc sets save-exact. The lockfile is committed only after the install-time list is approved.

nodes.label: ESLint and Prettier
nodes.rationale: ESLint flat config with typescript-eslint plus Prettier. Root lint is eslint with max-warnings 0 plus tsc --noEmit per package. Biome was rejected by the user.

nodes.label: createApp Separated From Listen
nodes.rationale: createApp is separate from server.ts so Supertest imports the app without opening a port. A centralized error handler and requestId middleware use the SDS section 4 error shape and return no stack traces.

nodes.label: Backend parseEnv
nodes.rationale: The Zod env schema stays in the backend because env is not a cross-app contract. parseEnv returns a result or name-and-reason pairs. server.ts prints names and reasons and exits 1. Values are never included, and Zod messages map to a fixed reason set. The web app reads only VITE_API_URL.

nodes.label: GET /api/health
nodes.rationale: Returns 200 with status ok, no auth, and no database call, and is mounted before later auth middleware. It is added to the draft OpenAPI as x-proposed. A database readiness probe was deferred because it needs a 503 the SDS status map does not contain.

nodes.label: Prisma Datasource Without Models
nodes.rationale: schema.prisma has a generator and a PostgreSQL datasource only. Connectivity is SELECT 1, not a migration. Database tests are tagged so pnpm test passes without Postgres; test:db runs them against compose Postgres 16. prisma generate runs before typecheck.

nodes.label: Local docker-compose Postgres 16
nodes.rationale: docker-compose.yml pins postgres 16 to a patch tag, uses a named volume, and takes local-dev credentials from .env only.

nodes.label: Vitest Supertest Playwright Scaffold
nodes.rationale: Vitest per package, Supertest for the API, and Playwright in the frontend with webServer wiring but only a skipped placeholder. test:e2e stays a separate script that needs confirmation. One sample unit test per package and one Supertest health test.
